title: Population Ecology
definition: The study of how biotic populations interact with their environment, focusing on factors that influence population size, density, distribution, and age structure over time.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding biodiversity loss, conservation biology, sustainable development, and demographic dividend questions in both Prelims and Mains (GS Paper III).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Population Ecology.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
